fields.System.Title: INT-201 — Publish receipt confirmations
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a finance team member, I want the ERP told what was actually received, so that
supplier invoices are matched against real deliveries.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a confirmed receipt, then an event is written to the outbox in the same
  • transaction carrying received quantities per line, batches, and any discrepancies.
  • - Given the ERP being unavailable, then the event is retried and receiving is unaffected.
  • - Given a short or over receipt, then the event states both expected and actual so the
  • ERP can reconcile.
  • - Given repeated delivery failure, then the event dead-letters and alerts.
  • - Given duplicate delivery, then the ERP is documented as required to deduplicate on
  • event_id.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform, inbound |
| Tables | outbox |
| Risks | Event lost after commit ([doc 09 §2.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration · event assertion |
